Messages.Author: Camo1000
Messages.Body:
Just wondering if Toy can enter combat using Yawp Court. Toys card states that he cannot act or block.

However the wording of Yawp court is that the vampire taps and enters combat with the vampire so its neither acting nor blocking.

Opinions?

--Paul

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body: As far as I know, he can, exactly like he can use his Slave rule to enter combat.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
The combat created by Yawp Court is neither an action nor a block. Toy can be chosen by the Yawp Court.

Prince of Paris, France
